$description: Lumen v0.13 — EXPRESSIVE-mode ambient gradient primitives. Three lighter-weight gradients for surfaces that want a hint of expressive atmosphere without a full mesh recipe. Use these on cards, hero scrims, edge lighting — anything that wants the expressive mood without the four-radial mesh cost. All three are CSS `background:` value strings; consumers paste directly. Same prefers-reduced-transparency fallback policy as mesh.tokens.json (collapses to solid surface via @media in dist/css/lumen.scoping.css).

canvas-ambient.$description: Very subtle radial gradient from obsidian.900 at center to obsidian.800 at edges — suggests a faint lit-from-within feel. Used as the default expressive page canvas where mesh would be too heavy.

hero-scrim.$description: Vertical fade from surface.glass at top to transparent at 40% — for text overlay on a mesh background. Sits BETWEEN the mesh and the headline so the headline reads at high contrast over the brightest mesh stops.
hero-scrim.$value: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-alpha-ink-62, rgba(13,13,13,0.62)) 0%, var(--color-alpha-ink-40, rgba(13,13,13,0.40)) 20%, transparent 40%)

card-edge.$description: Diagonal hairline gradient for card edges in expressive mode — lifts them subtly above the mesh. Composed on the card border, not the body.
card-edge.$value: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-alpha-paper-10, rgba(255,255,255,0.10)) 0%, transparent 50%, var(--color-alpha-paper-06, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)) 100%)
